# Scott Hynd

Scott Hynd provides practical AI and business automation help for local operators.

Website: https://scotthynd.com/
Email: scott@scotthynd.com
Location: Brisbane, Queensland, Australia

## What Scott Helps With

- AI possibility checks for small businesses
- missed enquiry and quote follow-up workflows
- repeated customer question and FAQ reply builders
- admin cleanup and weekly owner catch-up workflows
- website clarity improvements
- practical visibility fixes for Google, AI tools, and customers

## Positioning

Plain-English help turning repeated business tasks, enquiry follow-up, quote chasing, admin friction, and website confusion into simple tools, workflows, and next steps.

## Best Fit

- local service businesses
- small business owners
- consultants and small teams
- businesses relying on enquiries, quotes, referrals, reputation, and consistent follow-up

## Not A Fit

- hype-led AI transformation programs
- enterprise AI strategy projects
- vague automation without a real business problem

## Primary Offer

Send through a business, website, or one repeated admin task, and Scott can suggest practical places where AI, a simple workflow, or a small tool could help.
